title: ESP32 and Embedded Experiment Runner
inputs: fkey_instrument/device.py (the existing ESP32-CYD fail-off twin whose pattern this extends: arm leases, latched faults, hash-chained log)
r15/protocol_runner.py (P07: REAL/SYNTHETIC/REPLAY/FAULT_INJECTION mode discipline, reused as a pattern)
tests: focused: the twin executes an in-bounds DDS recipe to completion, one artifact per segment; a synthetic observation, not a measurement

focused: a twin run is a pure function of (recipe, seed, epoch); same inputs yield a byte-identical run hash; a different seed changes the realized setpoints; the recipe compile-hash is stable and content-addressed
focused: fail-off on a lost heartbeat -- check_watchdog fires past the watchdog window, output goes off, HEARTBEAT_LOST latches; a heartbeat inside the window keeps RUNNING
focused: over-temperature interlock trips to FAULT_LATCHED with output off; emergency stop latches; faults clear only by explicit acknowledgement while off
focused: output is off at boot and can be on only in RUNNING (off in RECIPE_VALID and ARMED, on after start, off after stop)
focused: the hash-chained event log verifies intact; a tampered payload is detected at the tampered sequence number

negative: an out-of-range output command is refused (UnsafeOutputError) before the output stage is engaged and the run faults; refuse_unsafe_output names the violations; an in-bounds setpoint is accepted
negative: an out-of-band recipe faults at load rather than half-loading (recipe stays None); a recipe over max-continuous is invalid

negative: a run without a valid single-use arm lease is refused (ArmLeaseError) -- no arm, no recipe, expired lease, wrong token all refuse; refuse_run_without_arm_lease enforces the ARMED+lease precondition; the lease is single-use
negative: a twin run is not a hardware run (refuse_twin_as_hardware_run raises TwinAsHardwareError); a twin run never carries a measurement class
negative: a REAL-mode run is BLOCKED_MISSING_INPUT with zero artifacts (NO_BOARD_TO_FLASH); deploy_to_board is blocked; self-test reports firmware_compiled=false and board_flashed=false
modes: FAULT_INJECTION drives the first segment out of band and stops on the over-range interlock; REPLAY re-emits supplied frames; both remain SYNTHETIC_OBSERVATION
schema: a TwinRun record conforms to experiment_run.schema.json; this receipt conforms to phase_receipt.schema.json (validated with jsonschema)
negative_results: No firmware was compiled and no board was flashed. There is no ESP32/embedded board and no build toolchain in this environment; the runner is a deterministic software twin only. A real deployment (deploy_to_board and RunMode.REAL) is recorded as BLOCKED_MISSING_INPUT with zero artifacts and the reason NO_BOARD_TO_FLASH.

No physical measurement was produced. A twin recipe run yields a SYNTHETIC_OBSERVATION reproducible from the seed, never a PHYSICAL_MEASUREMENT; refuse_twin_as_hardware_run refuses any promotion of a twin run to a hardware measurement, and a twin run never carries a measurement class.

The output stage is never engaged outside its conservative, configurable limits: an out-of-band setpoint command is refused before the output is touched and the run faults OVER_RANGE, and an out-of-band recipe faults INVALID_RECIPE at load rather than half-loading.

The output cannot stay on without a live heartbeat: once the gap since the last heartbeat exceeds the watchdog window the watchdog fires, the output goes off, and a HEARTBEAT_LOST fault latches. Over-temperature and emergency-stop drive the same fail-off.

There is no auto-arm and no override: the output can be engaged only from ARMED with a fresh, matching, unexpired, single-use arm lease. A run without an arm lease, with an expired lease, or with a wrong token is refused, and the lease is consumed on start.
measured_here is nothing and PHYSICAL_VALIDATION_NOT_CLAIMED; the twin operates no apparatus.
reopening_test: python -m pytest tests/v8/test_embedded_runner.py -q  # this phase reopens if any of the 33 tests fails, if a twin/replay/fault-injection TwinRun ever carries a measurement-class claim_class, if a RunMode.REAL run produces raw artifacts or a status other than BLOCKED_MISSING_INPUT, if the output flag is ever True in any state other than RUNNING, if the watchdog fails to fail-off on a lost heartbeat, if an out-of-range setpoint or recipe reaches the output stage, or if a run reaches RUNNING without a fresh single-use arm lease. Real board deployment reopens from BLOCKED_MISSING_INPUT to a physical class only when an actual board, a build toolchain, a flashing record, and a calibration/specimen/fixture binding exist -- none of which are present here.

claims.statement: A deterministic software twin of an ESP32/embedded controller that executes a compiled DDS recipe under a fail-off state machine (output off at boot, single-use arm lease to arm, explicit start to run) with a heartbeat watchdog, over-range and over-temperature interlocks, latched faults, bounded outputs, and a SHA-256 hash-chained event log. No firmware is compiled and no board is flashed.

Executing a compiled recipe against the twin under a seed produces a reproducible TwinRun of synthetic realized setpoints. It is never a physical measurement and a real board deployment is BLOCKED_MISSING_INPUT.

privacy_check: CLEAN - synthetic fixtures only, no private inputs

All nonphysical work (twin, safety interlocks, recipe/DDS protocol, tests, docs) is COMPLETE; only the physical deployment is blocked.
